Date: 2022-12-21 What is claimed is:
1. A method of personalizing a speed limiter for a vehicle, the method comprising:
causing the speed limiter to be activated;
receiving a user input on a user interface, the user input including a speed limiter personalization setting; and
causing the speed limiter personalization setting to be implemented.
2. The method of claim 1, wherein the speed limiter personalization setting includes traffic sign speed limit recognition, and wherein causing the speed limiter personalization setting to be implemented includes:
acquiring visual data of a driving environment of the vehicle;
analyzing the visual data to detect whether a speed limit sign is present in the visual data;
responsive to detecting a speed limit sign in the visual data, determining a speed limit based on the speed limit sign; and
adjusting the speed limiter based on the speed limit determined based on the speed limit sign.
3. The method of claim 1, wherein the speed limiter personalization setting includes map- based speed limit recognition, and wherein causing the speed limiter personalization setting to be implemented includes:
determining a current location of the vehicle on a map;
determining whether the map includes speed limit information for the current location of the vehicle; and
responsive to determining that the map includes speed limit information for the current location of the vehicle, adjusting the speed limiter based on the speed limit information for the current location of the vehicle.
4. The method of claim 1, wherein the speed limiter personalization setting includes traffic sign speed limit recognition and map-based speed limit recognition, and wherein causing the speed limiter personalization setting to be implemented includes:
acquiring visual data of a driving environment of the vehicle analyzing the visual data to detect whether a speed limit sign is present in the visual data;
responsive to detecting that a speed limit sign is present in the visual data:
determining a speed limit based on the speed limit sign; and
adjusting a setting of the speed limiter based on the determined speed limit; and
responsive to determining that a speed limit sign is not present in the visual data:
determining a current location of the vehicle on a map;
determining whether the map includes speed limit information for the current location of the vehicle; and
responsive to determining that the map includes speed limit information for the current location of the vehicle, adjusting a setting of the speed limiter based on the speed limit information for the current location of the vehicle.
5. The method of claim 1, wherein the speed limiter personalization setting includes a user defined setting of the speed limiter.
6. The method of claim 5, wherein the user defined setting of the speed limiter is a speed limit distance trigger before a reduced speed limit zone, whereby the user can select when the speed limiter will be triggered before the reduced speed limit zone.
7. The method of claim 5, wherein the user defined setting of the speed limiter is a brake setting, whereby a user can select whether to brake sharply or softly upon triggering the speed limiter.
8. The method of claim 1, wherein the speed limiter personalization setting is for a recommendation-based speed limiter suggestion by an artificial intelligence model.
9. The method of claim 1, wherein the user interface is a visual user interface, and further including:
presenting a speed limiter element to a user on the visual user interface.
10. A system for personalizing a speed limiter for a vehicle, the system comprising:
a user interface; and
one or more processors operatively connected to the user interface, the one or more processors being programmed to initiate executable operations comprising:
causing the speed limiter to be activated;
receiving a user input on the user interface, the user input including a speed limiter personalization setting; and
causing the speed limiter personalization setting to be implemented.
11. The system of claim 10, wherein the speed limiter personalization setting includes traffic sign speed limit recognition, and wherein causing the speed limiter personalization setting to be implemented includes:
acquiring visual data of a driving environment of the vehicle;
analyzing the visual data to detect whether a speed limit sign is present in the visual data;
responsive to detecting a speed limit sign in the visual data, determining a speed limit based on the speed limit sign; and
adjusting the speed limiter based on the speed limit determined based on the speed limit sign.
12. The system of claim 10, wherein the speed limiter personalization setting includes map- based speed limit recognition, and wherein causing the speed limiter personalization setting to be implemented includes:
determining a current location of the vehicle on a map;
determining whether the map includes speed limit information for the current location of the vehicle; and
responsive to determining that the map includes speed limit information for the current location of the vehicle, adjusting the speed limiter based on the speed limit information for the current location of the vehicle.
13. The system of claim 10, wherein the speed limiter personalization setting includes traffic sign speed limit recognition and map-based speed limit recognition, and wherein causing the speed limiter personalization setting to be implemented includes:
acquiring visual data of a driving environment of the vehicle analyzing the visual data to detect whether a speed limit sign is present in the visual data;
responsive to detecting that a speed limit sign is present in the visual data:
determining a speed limit based on the speed limit sign; and
adjusting a setting of the speed limiter based on the determined speed limit; and
responsive to determining that a speed limit sign is not present in the visual data:
determining a current location of the vehicle on a map;
determining whether the map includes speed limit information for the current location of the vehicle; and
responsive to determining that the map includes speed limit information for the current location of the vehicle, adjusting a setting of the speed limiter based on the speed limit information for the current location of the vehicle.
14. The system of claim 10, wherein the speed limiter personalization setting includes a user defined setting of the speed limiter.
15. The system of claim 14, wherein the user defined setting of the speed limiter is a speed limit distance trigger before a reduced speed limit zone, whereby the user can select when the speed limit will be triggered before the reduced speed limit zone.
16. The system of claim 15, wherein the user defined setting of the speed limiter is a brake setting, whereby a user can select a degree of braking upon triggering the speed limiter.
17. The system of claim 10, wherein the speed limiter personalization setting is for a recommendation-based speed limiter suggestion by an artificial intelligence model.
18. The system of claim 10, further including:
presenting a speed limiter element to a user on the user interface.
19. The system of claim 10, wherein the user interface is a visual user interface, wherein the visual user interface is one of:
a graphical user interface presented on a display; and
a projection presented on a surface.
20. The system of claim 19, wherein the visual user interface the visual user interface is located within a vehicle. 26 27 28 29 30
